## Adversarial coverage

- Independent stable and phase-authority substitutions are rejected.
- Parent, harness, and verifier reject lone high and low surrogates, C0, DEL, C1, Arabic letter mark, directional marks, bidi embeddings, overrides and isolates, non-NFC text, reserved names, trailing aliases, traversal, separator aliases, and case aliases. A valid supplementary-plane name is preserved exactly.
- Cache validation rejects the repository root, repository descendants, repository ancestors, and symlink aliases before cache tool resolution. Unsafe Unicode is rejected before realpath access. A disjoint supplementary-plane cache path is accepted.
- Package closure rejects missing, extra, substituted, symbolic-link, and hard-link materializations while preserving the Revision 19 trust controls and prior behavioral coverage.
